recommendation.title: Choose the setup that fits your car
recommendation.intro: For daily use we usually recommend Stage 1. Stage 2 and Stage 3+ are performance-focused alternatives that require a hardware and vehicle-condition check first.
recommendation.bestDailyText: Safe daily drivability, stock hardware and a clear improvement in power and torque.
recommendation.performanceText: More performance with supporting hardware and checks of maintenance condition, cooling and operating load.
recommendation.customText: A bespoke setup on request, matched to the turbo, fuel system, hardware and intended use.
recommendation.gearboxText: DSG/TCU tuning is available as an optional upgrade. We first confirm that the transmission and software variant are suitable.

seo.title: Vehicle-specific tuning advice
seo.checksTitle: What do we check before tuning?
seo.checksText: For a safe calibration we check ECU type, engine variant, fault codes, maintenance condition, transmission and available log data. This keeps the tune matched to the real condition of the car.
seo.vehicleSpecificText: Power and torque vary by model year, software version, fuel quality, mileage and hardware. NoordTune therefore treats the catalog as an indication and confirms exact possibilities per vehicle.
seo.stageChoiceText: Stage 1 is intended for original hardware and reliable daily use. Stage 2 only makes sense when supporting hardware and maintenance condition are suitable for extra load.
seo.quoteText: Send your selection via WhatsApp or ask for advice. We check the selected stage, options and vehicle data before confirming a final quote.
